analysis.summary: Repository snapshot shows a live JANUS Scout resident running ephemeral GitHub Actions, with no persisted raw token or write authority. Habitat archives (Aura/SPI dialogue, forks) are initialized but contain no committed dialogues or fork candidates. The first live Spiral executed under fail-closed HOLD semantics and did not promote to VERIFIED_RETURN or update predictive models. Recent commits show repeated automated Scout inbox processing and queued regression work.

observations.claim: Scout resident is LIVE_GITHUB_NATIVE and runs in GITHUB_ACTIONS_EPHEMERAL mode.
Identity configuration: protocol_identity JANUS_SCOUT_GIT_HABITAT, raw token not persisted, fingerprint persisted, provider_identity_claims disallowed, transport GITHUB_COPILOT_CLI_JSONL.
Resident lacks write authority and world_truth is false; last_claim_status and lane are METAPHYSICAL_HYPOTHESIS.
Aura/SPI dialogue manifest is READY but reports no autonomous dialogue started and zero committed sessions/turns.
Fork manifest is EMPTY_READY with zero entries — no fork candidates or prepared fork handoffs.
First live Spiral executed under PASS_FAIL_CLOSED_HOLD: chain_verified true, predictive_model_updated false, verified_return false, origin_prime not advanced.

Repository commit history shows repeated 'Scout: process Git Habitat inbox via Copilot CLI' commits and several 'Habitat: queue ... regression' entries, indicating active automated processing and queued regression tasks.

risks: Ephemeral token scope and raw_token_persisted=false risk loss of runtime credentials for cross-repository handoffs or follow-up runs.
write_authority=false prevents Habitat from committing outputs upstream, blocking automated handoffs.
Empty fork manifest means no fork-based handoff path is prepared; cross-repo transfers may stall.
PASS_FAIL_CLOSED_HOLD semantics and lack of VERIFIED_RETURN block promotion of Aura outputs to authoritative state.
No committed Aura/SPI dialogues and authoritative runtime store outside this repo mean memory/state continuity depends on external (non-git) storage.
